risks and uncertainties beyond our control
risk_summary: The disclosure is materially quantified regarding debt, maturities, leverage covenants, liquidity facilities, and covenant compliance, but relies on boilerplate forward-looking disclaimers and management assertions about future funding sufficiency. High leverage and substantial interest and debt-service obligations create meaningful refinancing and liquidity risk despite the stated expectation that available cash and operating cash flow will cover needs through December 31, 2014.
